basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old tech enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. I work as a junior software developer, and in my spare time, I love diving into new hobbies like mechanical keyboards and experimenting with different switch types. I'm still figuring out my preferences but enjoy linear switches the most. I live with my partner and our two cats. I often browse Reddit during late evenings after work and on weekends. I'm also dealing with vestibular migraines, which has led me to explore communities around health and well-being.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, having graduated with a bachelor's degree two years ago. My interest in mechanical keyboards began recently when I decided to improve my work-from-home setup. Most of my knowledge comes from online research and community feedback, as I'm still learning the intricacies of different switch types and keyboard brands.
